summary: Regression pass after code-review fixes on Ritme (Kerja Rutin). All 15 backend pytest tests passed (auth, task CRUD, weekly stats, Claude Sonnet 4.5 AI insight). Frontend end-to-end regression verified via Playwright: register -> dashboard -> tasks page loads task list on mount (useCallback + useEffect deps correct) -> toggle status refreshes list -> filter works -> /evaluasi renders stats + performance score -> generate AI insight renders MarkdownLite with headings/bullets/paragraphs -> Buat Ulang re-generates without errors. Zero React key/duplicate warnings in console. All 3 targeted fixes (backend insight_text init, Tasks.jsx useCallback, Evaluation.jsx stable keys) work without regressions.

issues: Recharts chart-container width(-1)/height(-1) warning when there is no data (console warning only, not user-facing). Consider gating chart render on non-empty by_day data or setting min width/height.

regression_verification.backend_insight_text_init: PASS - POST /api/evaluations/weekly/insight still returns valid Bahasa Indonesia insight (1592 chars, 4 headings, 3 bullet lists, 10 items). No pre-assignment bug introduced.
regression_verification.tasks_useCallback_useEffect: PASS - Tasks page renders 3 seeded tasks on mount, toggleStatus refreshes list, filter select re-filters — no infinite render loop or missing dependency issue observed.
regression_verification.evaluation_markdown_stable_keys: PASS - MarkdownLite renders headings + bullets + paragraphs + bold correctly. Buat Ulang (regenerate) works. Console captured 0 React key or duplicate-key warnings across full flow.

action_items: (Optional, low priority) Suppress Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warning on empty by_day by conditionally rendering or providing default sizing.

(Known, from iter1) Dev-server webpack overlay iframe occasionally intercepts pointer events after Radix Dialog operations in preview URL — not a code bug, but consider disabling client-overlay in preview build.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is defined at line 370 but used at line 339 inside the exception handler for /evaluations/weekly/insight. Because module-level code executes top-to-bottom, `logger` DOES resolve at call time (module fully loaded by request time), so this works — but reordering (move logger.basicConfig / getLogger above the routes) would be clearer.

Evaluation.jsx MarkdownLite: renderInline uses `p.slice(0,8)` in key which could collide across two identical short spans. Low-risk since text and index `i` both contribute, but for absolute safety concat both prefix+suffix or use crypto hash. Not blocking.
Frontend uses localStorage for JWT (`kr_token`) — flagged in previous review as intentionally out-of-scope; still worth planning httpOnly cookie migration for XSS resistance.
test_credentials: Registered fresh users reg2/reg3/reg4_<uid>@ritme.app / testing123 during test; canonical test@ritme.app/testing123 also exists per /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 dated tasks (status: selesai/proses/belum, categories kerja/belajar) for reg4_* via authenticated fetch inside browser context, then verified UI list load + evaluation stats.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://task-evaluator-6.preview.emergentagent.com. Frontend routes /masuk /dasbor /tugas /evaluasi. JWT in localStorage['kr_token']. When seeding via external HTTP client, cluster may 403 non-browser UAs — use page.evaluate(fetch) from browser context or a proper requests.Session with browser-like headers. All UI actions require killing #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay before clicks after Radix Dialog interactions in preview URL. Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~16s and is safe to re-run.
rca of the issue: N/A - regression only, no bugs found in applied fixes.
